# 减选关键帧偏移

Ordered selection offset: once moves all except first by offset; batch gives offsets 0,offset,2*offset,... . Moves every existing key with dense-key collision protection.

- 工具 ID：stagger_offset
- 领域：[[knowledge/_generated/领域/animation|动画与动作]]
